errors.rationale: A CSS property has no runtime error channel: an unsupported or malformed declaration is dropped at parse time per CSS error-handling, which is exactly the progressive-enhancement path the examples' @supports gate documents. Source: css-text-decor-4 propdef (no error states defined).

Keyword values have no error behavior beyond the property-level parse-drop documented for the property item; an invalid keyword invalidates the declaration per CSS error handling. Source: css-text-decor-4 propdef.
